patch.value: Match current published claim and session-lock refusal envelopes
Supersede the dependency-only update with native refusal parity against pm-cli 2026.11.11. Keep every differential assertion exact and run every differential target.

value.author: codex-rust164-1111
value.text: Confirmed current npm latest is 2026.11.11 and updated the locked published oracle. Baseline differential runs precede native changes. Centralize refusal recovery, scope and redaction; retain byte comparisons and all existing cases.

value.author: codex-rust164-1111

value.author: codex-rust164-1111
value.text: The expanded orientation pass reached 25 of 32 passing before the final shared fixes: matching-active test health, root-edge cost reservation and incident-root edge ordering. All 397 library unit tests pass; the focused CLI/bin/parity run then passed 44 binary tests, 18 CLI dispatch tests and 14 parity contracts. Corrected the final ownership fault expectation to require the published warning. Running all eight differential targets through linked pm tests, sequentially, with each cargo command capped at 1200 seconds and two test threads.

value.author: codex-rust164-1111
value.text: Full differential rerun exposed additional shared compact-envelope drift: TOON brief/search metadata, relationship-bound omission declarations, and configured lifecycle fallback. Correcting producers and the common renderer while retaining exact stream comparisons. Close, conformance and list targets already pass; scoped credential and ownership provenance regressions pass focused checks.

value.author: codex-rust164-1111
value.text: Behavioral reverts in disposable copies: replacing only refusal credential projection with a no-op fails the scoped credential differential; reverting only ownership_error_json fails the ownership-provenance differential; reverting only TOON table encoding fails the small-search differential. Each failure was an assertion failure, and all scratch functions were restored. The fixed scoped test passes in both JSON and human output; the final full differential run will recheck all three tests. Clippy and fmt pass. The previous envelope gate passed 504 tests; refreshing it after the final human-output correction. Aggregate release-check runs the full suite twice including branch coverage, exceeding the requested 45-minute budget based on measured target durations; CI retains unchanged aggregate thresholds.

value.author: codex-rust164-1111
value.text: Final claim/release differential: 29 passed, 0 failed, including both new credential/scope and ownership-provenance regressions after restoration. Remaining differential targets and the final envelope refresh continue sequentially.

value.author: codex-rust164-1111
value.text: The complete interim rerun reached 118 passed and 4 failed: one unchanged five-second relationship deadline, one Unicode intent-budget/continuation case, and two later search-limit TOON cases. Prepared source fixes now cache exact packet shapes across recovery probes, apply canonical cost precedence and finalized-envelope overhead through the same intent projection, and format numeric filter echoes with JavaScript number semantics. The Unicode test follows the emitted producer cursor with --after and independently exercises snapshot compaction while retaining its exact stream, SDK, surrogate-pair and tail-count assertions. No budget assertion or byte comparison was loosened. Rechecking these changes before another full run.

value.author: codex-rust164-1111
value.text: Focused positive checks now pass both output-parity tests and the unchanged relationship five-second deadline. Refreshed four independent behavioral reverts all fail at assertions: credential projection, ownership envelope construction, TOON table encoding, and canonical intent-budget preparation. value.author: codex-rust164-1111
value.text: The cache counter boundary now has a fifth independent behavioral revert proof: resetting only its starting width chooses 999 instead of the published 1000 fixed point and fails the exact rendering unit assertion. Final search, orientation, output-parity and pagination targets have passed; the affected orientation target will be refreshed once more after the counter correction, and the envelope gate includes the strengthened unit test.

value.author: codex-rust164-1111
value.text: Final verification complete: every differential target passes, 122 passed and zero failed/ignored (including two new refusal regressions), versus the initial 59 passed and 61 failed across 120 tests. The final orientation refresh passes all 32 after the counter-width correction. Envelope gate: 505 passed, zero failed/ignored (398 lib, 44 binary, 18 dispatch, 11 ownership, 14 parity, 20 release-pipeline). Clippy and fmt pass; five independent behavioral reverts fail as expected and were restored. Exact commands and per-target counts are recorded in docs/NATIVE_PARITY_2026_11_11.md. Measured differential runtime is about 30 minutes, so the aggregate normal and coverage passes exceed the requested 45-minute local limit; CI must certify unchanged aggregate/coverage thresholds and other platforms. Potential published auditability regression: claim/start can succeed with an attribution warning while the same stale session lock still refuses release. No upstream issue was filed. Releasing the claim without closing the task.
